LanguageData.Gun_MP5SD3_RWP.description: The MP5SD3 is a compact, integrally suppressed submachine gun renowned for its low noise operation and reliability. Designed for stealth and close-quarters combat, it combines a high rate of fire with excellent accuracy, making it a favorite for special operations. Ideal for colonists who prefer to silently eliminate threats without alerting nearby enemies.
